```cypher
MATCH (m:Maintainer)-[:MAINTAINS]->(p:Plugin)
WHERE m.display_name = 'Gareth Barnard'
AND (p.last_release_ts IS NULL OR p.last_release_ts < (apoc.date.parse('2026-09-10', 'yyyy-MM-dd').epochMillis / 1000) - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60))
RETURN p.component, p.name, p.last_release_ts
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT 100
```
